name: forecast_demand
description: Generate a daily demand forecast for a product SKU with confidence intervals, seasonal factors, peak day, and accuracy metrics (MAPE, RMSE, bias).

days_ahead.description: Number of days to forecast, e.g. 7, 14, 30, 60, 90 (max 90) (Default: 30)

name: get_demand_trends
description: Analyze demand trends for a category over a period: units/revenue/AOV growth, weekly sales data, top growing and declining SKUs, and seasonality index.

category.description: Product category (e.g., electronics, apparel, grocery, home, sports, all)

period.description: Analysis period (One of: week, month, quarter, year; Default: month)

name: auto_reorder
description: Calculate an automatic reorder recommendation for a SKU using the Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) model with safety stock, reorder point, lead time, and annual cost analysis.

sku.description: Product SKU to calculate reorder for

name: get_abc_analysis
description: Perform ABC analysis on inventory classifying items by value contribution (A: top 20% SKUs / 80% revenue, B, C) with fill rates, turnover, and optimization recommendations.
